source: codex debug models (installed Codex CLI 0.147.0 / client_version 0.149.0) — a real, official, local, machine-readable CLI subcommand (`codex debug models --help`: "Render the raw model catalog as JSON"). This file is the JSON_FALLBACK snapshot the loader uses only when that live command is unavailable at probe time (offline, CLI not installed, unexpected output shape); when the command succeeds, its live output is normalized and used instead — see src/pm/codex-model-catalogue.mjs. Only models with visibility "list" from the live catalogue are included; "hide"-visibility entries (gpt-reserve, codex-auto-review) are internal and are not owner-facing choices, so they are intentionally excluded here.
